status_note: IN PROGRESS: backend only (demo sandbox, onboarding state, routes). The front end (tour.js/tour.css, page wiring, i18n, settings button), the ADR and the R-/E-/FEAT- registrations are later steps.
summary: Onboarding tour backend: a read-only-for-the-person's-data demo project (pdh-demo) served from a throw-away offline SQLite sandbox built from a built-in fixture (29 public arXiv Transformer-lineage papers: 5 unrated candidates + 24 earlier records spread over four weeks, with categories, pinned-term history and pre-written zh/en previews); request routing by header X-PDH-Demo or project_id with an allow list and a 403 demo_readonly for everything else; /api/onboarding (state, start, done) with state in onboarding.json; /api/projects carries a demo descriptor; app_version.current(); first-run assertions in the packaged-backend verifier.
scope_note: Worktree onboarding-tour, second commit on top of the no-default-project commit. No front-end file is touched, so nothing in the UI uses these routes yet. The demo makes zero model calls and zero network requests: the gateway is read-only, sources and the PDF fetcher are offline stubs, and the tests close sockets to everything but loopback and make Gateway.call raise.

budget_impact.rationale: The demo triage writes pre-written previews (model=demo); no provider is called, no prompt registered, no retry. The sandbox gateway cannot call a model even with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set.
budget_impact.after: demo with zero tokens and no network

additional_checks.command: python3 scripts/verify_packaged_route.py <wrapper running the source backend>
additional_checks.scope: including the new first-run block; NOT run against a frozen binary

open_risks: The arXiv identifiers, titles, dates of the 29 fixture papers were written from memory and the abstracts are the author's paraphrases: export.arxiv.org was unreachable from the sandbox, so nothing was verified online (harness/sources.json DEMO-FIXTURE-ARXIV, recheck in 7 days).
The organization worker lock is global: a demo graph job and a real organization job exclude each other (the loser gets 'already running').
A request that sends X-PDH-Demo gets the sandbox for every non-settings route; the page must send the header only while the tour is on screen.
Windows cannot delete an open sandbox file; the old generation then stays until the next reset (tested by simulating a failed delete, not on Windows).
Direction names in the sandbox library are written in the language chosen at reset time; switching the interface language mid-tour does not rename them.
No front end exists yet: sessionStorage survival across pages in WKWebView/WebView2 is still an inference.
